window.description: The length of the exponential moving average, as TradingView's ta.ema(source, length). One value folds the newest unbroken run of bars, up to the readable depth, and needs at least the bars after which the average's seed weighs at most 0.1 % — 73 bars at length 20 — so it is null when the newest bars hold fewer present values in a row. A stored EMA metric is the exact source at its own length.

buffer.description: How near a TOUCH must come to the level, in whole basis points of the level; a column carries this or touchAtr, never both. At 0, the default, a TOUCH is exact contact: the bar reaches the level and closes exactly on it. "Reached and did not close through" is an in clause over the TOUCH and REJECT labels of a side, and a close through the level is the distance crossing (BREAK), which reads none here. Only TOUCH reads the buffer; a REJECT pierces the level itself. A distance of X% is a buffer of X × 100 bps.

touchAtr.description: How near a TOUCH must come to the level, as a multiple of the ATR14 of the column's own timeframe at the prior bar; a column carries this or buffer, never both. Only TOUCH reads it: a close through the level still reads none and a REJECT still reads where the prior bar has no ATR, and a TOUCH reads no value there.

A scope holding fewer than 5 coins in the set ranks none. Accepted only where the column ranks the tracked universe.
